title: 第21章 想法成真！幻破粉！
novel_title: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
content_zh:
沈云没办法，最终抱着鸵鸟蛋去了段式符斋。

    嘴皮子磨破了，暂做抵押，才换了两枚源石。

    符斋帮忙寄卖，卖了之后多退少补。

    回到家，关在房间中，感受着源石内的能量轨迹。

    没有犹豫。

    福报+

    【人道符师（学徒1/1000）+50】

    脑清目明，无数的感悟浮现沈云心头。

    伪顿悟。

    拿起早已准备好的墨钎和空白符石。

    提钎下落，石屑纷飞，符墨源源不断的注入其中。

    护体符文逐渐成型，在其中构建全新的能量脉络。

    沈云全身心的投入其中。

    终于，半个多时辰后，随着最后一笔抬起，符石表面布满了奇异的纹络。

    一道白光闪过。

    成了！

    【人道符师（学徒53/1000）】

    除却加的五十，成功制作出一块符石，还增长了两点进度。

    伪顿悟的状态消失后，沈云感觉身心疲倦。

    符文勾连的能量利用率达到六成多些，绝对合格的护体符石。

    沈云压抑心头喜悦，长出一口气，“我的想法没问题。”

    看着古卷上剩下295点的福德，他心中一片火热。

    还能制作五六块符石。

    不必等到入阶，学徒阶段就能借此赚钱了。

    “不知道这种伪顿悟状态下成功率是多少，一块下品护体符石九十金，成本三十金出头，成功一次就赚六十金！”

    沈云算了算，五成以上的成功率就是赚啊！

    不到一个时辰，赚了六十金。

    成功一次，可抵看护灵田四个月。

    果然打工没有出路。

    合该享受享受。

    沈云没乘胜追击，现在状态不好，他出门买了些灵米蛮兽肉，奢侈的买了一壶灵米酿。

    苏婉儿喜欢吃水果，也买几斤不同的灵果尝味道。

    “夫君，这是？”

    晚上，苏婉儿练完呼吸法看着满桌的菜肴，有些愕然。

    昨日夫君刚说要省钱。

    她刚想悄悄去把首饰都卖了，反正也用不到，不如补贴家用。

    “你看这是什么！”

    沈云轻抚白须，掏出自己篆刻的那枚护体符石，放在桌子上。

    “夫君，竟然成功了！”
content_en:
Shen Yun had no choice but to go to Duan Shi Fu Zhai with the ostrich eggs in his arms.

    His words were worn out, so he temporarily pledged his money and exchanged it for two Origin Stones.

    Fu Zhai helped sell the goods on consignment, and after the goods were sold, more money would be refunded and less money would be paid.

    After returning home, I locked myself in my room and felt the energy track in the Source Stone.

    No hesitation.

    Blessing +

    [Humanity Talisman Master (Apprentice 1/1000) +50]

    With his mind clear and his eyesight clear, countless insights emerged in Chen Yun's heart.

    Pseudo-epiphany.

    Pick up the ink hammer and blank runestones that have been prepared.

    As the hammer fell, stone chips flew into the air, and talisman and ink poured into it continuously.

    The protective runes gradually took shape, building a new energy vein in them.

    Shen Yun devoted himself wholeheartedly to it.

    Finally, more than half an hour later, as the last stroke was lifted, the surface of the runestone was covered with strange patterns.

    A flash of white light flashed.

    Done!

    [Humanitarian Talisman Master (Apprentice 53/1000)]

    In addition to the extra fifty, he successfully produced a runestone and gained two points of progress.

    After the pseudo-enlightenment state disappeared, Shen Yun felt physically and mentally tired.

    The energy utilization rate of rune linking reaches more than 60%, making it an absolutely qualified protective rune stone.

    Chen Yun suppressed the joy in his heart and let out a long breath, "My idea is fine."

    Looking at the 295 points of merit left on the ancient scroll, his heart became hot.

    It can also make five or six rune stones.

    You don't have to wait until you enter the advanced level, you can make money during the apprenticeship stage.

    "I don't know what the success rate is in this pseudo-enlightenment state. A low-grade protective talisman stone costs 90 gold and costs just over 30 gold. If you succeed, you can earn 60 gold!"

    Shen Yun did the math. A success rate of more than 50% would be a profit!

    In less than an hour, I made sixty gold.

    If you succeed once, you can stay in the care field for four months.

    Sure enough, there is no way out by working part-time.

    It deserves to be enjoyed.

    Shen Yun didn't take advantage of the victory and was in a bad state now. He went out and bought some spiritual rice beast meat and a luxurious pot of spiritual rice brew.

    Su Waner likes to eat fruits, and she also buys several kilograms of different spiritual fruits to taste them.

    "Husband, what is this?"

    In the evening, after Su Waner practiced breathing techniques, she looked at the dishes on the table with some surprise.

    Yesterday my husband just said that he wanted to save money.

    She just wanted to quietly sell all the jewelry. She wouldn't use it anyway, so it was better to subsidize the family.

    "Look what this is!"

    Chen Yun gently stroked his white beard, took out the protective talisman he had carved, and placed it on the table.

    "Husband, you succeeded!"
title_en: Chapter 21 Ideas come true! Fantasy powder!
